title: Arrearage Management Program Re-Base Window Schedule
content:
# Arrearage Management Program Re-Base Window Schedule

**Schedule.** For a program bill of an Arrearage Management Program plan, the forgiveness kind of Payment Arrangement, the re-base window — the period of the agreement's bills read for a re-base, counted back from the booking day — is:

| Space heating on the Electric Service Agreement | Plan's enrolled date | Re-base window |
|---|---|---|
| Electric | Any | The 12 months before booking |
| Not electric | At least 6 whole calendar months before booking | The 3 months before booking |
| Not electric | Fewer than 6 whole calendar months before booking | The 6 months before booking |

Months between the plan's enrolled date and the booking day are counted in whole calendar months. A window of a number of months before booking covers bills dated after the same calendar day that many months earlier, up to and including the booking date.

## Boundary cases (hypothetical gas-heated agreement, plan enrolled January 15)

| Booking day | Whole calendar months since enrollment | Re-base window |
|---|---|---|
| July 14 | 5 | 6 months |
| July 15 | 6 | 3 months |

For an all-electric home the window is 12 months whatever the plan's enrolled date.
